eyebrow: Statevector inspection: ground truth, no noise
code:
def test_bell_pair_statevector_exact():
  qc = build_bell_pair()
  sv = Statevector.from_instruction(qc)
  probs = sv.probabilities_dict()
  assert set(probs.keys()) == {'00','11'}
  assert abs(probs['00']-0.5) < 1e-9
  assert abs(probs['11']-0.5) < 1e-9
caption: If this fails, the bug is in the circuit's logic, full stop — there's no sampling-noise excuse available here.
